title: Passing in a hexcode color with alpha to a custom RichTextEffect does not function
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.1.stable.mono, 4.6.1.stable

### System information

Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8600K CPU @ 3.60GHz (6 threads) - 15.94 GiB memory

### Issue description

When creating a custom `RichTextEffect` and attempting to pass in a color argument, hex codes that include the alpha channel are parsed as `String` instead of `Color`.

E.g. If a `RichTextLabel` has the bbCode: `[custom color=#fff8]text[/custom]`, and a custom effect is as follows:

```gdscript
@tool
extends RichTextEffect
class_name CustomTextEffect

var bbcode = "custom"

func _process_custom_fx(char_fx):
	# Set the color to green if the argument is a color, or red if it is a string
	var color = char_fx.env.get("color")
	match typeof(color):
		TYPE_COLOR:
			char_fx.color = Color.GREEN
		TYPE_STRING:
			char_fx.color = Color.RED
	return true
```
The displayed text is shown as red, indicating that the argument has been parsed as a string and not a color as expected.

This issue seems to stem from the parsing in [`rich_text_label.cpp > parse_expressions_for_values`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/456bdea954ee24e48cb562bfbf531de1cd96e371/scene/gui/rich_text_label.cpp#L8346)

The regex: `color.compile("^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3})$")` would only pick up on non-alpha colors.

I believe the fix would be to change that line to `color.compile("^#([A-Fa-f0-9]{6}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{3}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{8}|[A-Fa-f0-9]{4})$")`

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the MRP provided, and open `main.tscn`. Note how the rich text label `AlphaColor` is shown in red, meaning the hex code with alpha has failed to be parsed, while the rich text label `NonAlphaColor` is shown in green, meaning the hex code without alpha has been parsed.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[rich-text-effect-min-repo.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26105225/rich-text-effect-min-repo.zip)
